newsitem.title: USA: FORE SHARES GAIN ON TAKEOVER SPECULATION.
newsitem.headline: FORE SHARES GAIN ON TAKEOVER SPECULATION.

text.p: Shares of FORE Systems Inc rose in active trade on Tuesday amid persistent market speculation that the computer networking equipment maker would be acquired by a telecommunications firm, analysts said.

Telecom systems company Lucent Technologies Inc and Northern Telecom Ltd were named as possible buyers of FORE, a prominent producer of networking products using asynchronous transfer mode (ATM) technology, they said.

"Rumors are flying fast and furiously about FORE being a takeover candidate," Andy Schopick, an analyst at Nutmeg Securities, said. "There is nothing specific to the company's business which would justify this kind of price and volume."
FORE shares added 1-10/16 to 19-13/16, on volume of 6.6 million shares. The company said it was against its policy to comment on takeover rumors.

FORE is frequently viewed as an acquisition target because it is one of a handful of independent ATM switch producers, its technology is well-regarded and it faces a more competitive market landscape which might make it amenable to a bid, analysts said.
"In this stock's case, it has been virtually impossible to quash takeover rumors," Schopick said.
Cabletron Systems Inc and Ascend Communications Inc had been pegged as possible buyers in the past, analysts said. Now rumors centered around Lucent, they said.
"Most of the current rumors are focusing around Lucent," Noel Lindsay, an analyst at Deutsche Morgan Grenfell, said. "Nortel has also been named frequently in the past."
Lucent said it did not comment on such speculation and Nortel was not immediately available to comment.
